reviews.title: Great shoe organizer — very useful and looks amazing!
reviews.body: I’m really happy with this shoe organizer. It was easy to assemble once you get the hang of the connectors, and the final setup looks neat and modern. The transparent doors make it easy to see everything, and the storage capacity is great — it really helped organize our garage and keep shoes dust-free.It’s lightweight but still sturdy when fully assembled. I also love the extra hooks and side pockets, which are surprisingly useful. A friend saw it at our place and immediately wanted to order one too because it really looks so clean and organized.Definitely worth it if you need a large, affordable shoe storage solution!

reviews.title: The durability of these bins is outstanding
reviews.body: I recently purchased the stackable storage bins from CUBEDIY and I'm thrilled with my purchase. These bins have transformed my shoe organization.What impresses me the most about these bins is their ability to maximize storage space. With 18 stackable bins, I now have a custom shoe storage cabinet that fits perfectly in my room. I can store up to 72 pairs of shoes, including larger boots and high heels by adjusting the shelves.The durability of these bins is outstanding. The sturdy polymer material and high-quality metal frame ensure long-lasting use. The transparent doors make it easy to find the right pair of shoes and protect them from dust. The setup was a breeze with clear instructions and included hardware.In conclusion, these stackable storage bins from CUBEDIY are a fantastic solution for shoe organization. Their space-saving design, durability, and transparent doors make them a top choice. If you're looking to revolutionize your shoe storage.

reviews.title: I enjoyed this!
reviews.body: I used this for my squish mallows instead of for shoes because I have a pretty big closet and it works perfectly for them! I will say once you get the hang of putting it together, it is pretty easy to assemble, it just takes some thought at first to assemble the product. I would anchor it to your wall for sure and ensure that you build everything tightly together because while it's sturdy on it's own, it is still plastic at the end of the day. I didn't use all 72 cubes because that would be big in my house but if you did use it all, it would be pretty big! Overall, I rate the product a 4 because it is an easy product to build once you get the hang of it, it is great for keeping things not just shoes in it, and it has stayed together very well!

features: MAXIMIZE YOUR STORAGE SPACE: Use the 18 stackable storage bins to build a custom white shoe storage cabinet that fits your room, and store up to 72 pairs of shoes in it! Our shoe closet can fit in larger boots and high heels, remove a shoe shelf from a shoe holder or place them horizontally. Our shoe organizer with cover can also serve as a garage shoe cabinet.

YOUR LONG-LASTING SHOE STORAGE SOLUTION: This shoe rack organizer is made of a sturdy polymer that’s 20% thicker than standard alternatives (300 microns) and rests on a high-quality painted metal frame with sturdy connectors making the whole storage organizer extra durable.

DUST-FREE AND CLEAR VIEW: All of these shoe boxes have transparent doors, so you won’t have any trouble spotting the right pair and will keep the inside of clear storage bins protected from dust. 360 air circulation in the shoe shelf with cover means no odors!

ADAPTABLE SHAPE AND EASY ASSEMBLY: These shoe organizer with cover, stackable and interchangeable, can be arranged into a single-block shoe storage organizer or into more-interesting configurations. Installing the shoe containers is simple as all the instructions and hardware are included.

EXTRA ORGANIZER ACCESSORIES FOR CLOSET: We’ve thrown in a hook rack and a hanging organizer to complement these portable shoe rack and to help you keep your shoe horns, polish, brushes, perhaps purses, and other paraphernalia as organized as your shoes now are. This purse and shoe organizer keeps your belongings neatly organized and free from clutter.
